title: Agent queue
summary: {concurrent} at a time · {used} of {perDay} runs today

sectionHints.next: Drag to change the order, or use Move up and Move down. The first one that is due starts first.
sectionHints.recent: Results of the last runs. A task moves to In review only when Hub verified its checks; you complete it.

empty.title: Nothing in the queue
empty.body: Run a task now or schedule it from its card, from Start with these in the panel, or with New run here.

banner.owner: The queue is paused. Runs already going finish; nothing new starts until you resume.
banner.limit: Your plan’s usage limit is reached, so the queue is paused. It continues once, {at}, oldest first. Nothing is retried before then.
banner.limitNoTime: Your plan’s usage limit is reached, so the queue is paused. Claude did not say when it resets: resume when you are ready.
banner.quiet: Quiet hours until {to}. Due runs wait, then start oldest first.

holds.usage_limit: Waits: the usage limit is reached
holds.concurrency: Waits for a running run to finish
holds.folder_busy: Waits: another run or chat is working in one of its folders
holds.signed_out: Waits: Claude is signed out on {device}
holds.engine_unavailable: Waits: Claude Code cannot run on {device}
holds.folder_not_allowed: This folder is no longer on the project’s list

failures.cut_off: A restart or a lost connection cut it off. It does not start again by itself.
failures.device_offline: The device went offline. It does not start again by itself.
failures.folder_not_allowed: Its folder is not on the project’s list.
failures.other: It ended with an error. Open its chat for what happened.

toasts.modeApproval: It will run with your approval
toasts.pendingStarted: A chat opened on {folder}. Approve the command there.

dialog.title: Schedule: {title}
dialog.promptHint: Plain words, as you would write in the panel. It runs in Execute.
dialog.repeat: Repeat every week on this day
dialog.noDevice: No paired device is online, so a run waits until one is.
dialog.noFolder: This project has no linked folder. Link one in Settings › Devices.
dialog.missed: If the device is off then, it starts when it is back, oldest first.
dialog.approval: With my approval, it pauses on any command that needs you and waits with no time limit, in the Inbox and here.
dialog.pastTime: That time has passed, so it would start at once.
dialog.modeApprovalHint: Pauses on commit, push, delete, deploy, a new branch or worktree, docker and any command not allowed, and waits for you with no time limit.
dialog.modeAutomaticHint: Never waits for you. Questions take the recommended option. Anything that needs approval is skipped, never run, and kept as a pending item for you to run later.
dialog.extraHint: Other folders of this project, given to Claude Code as more directories. All of them stay held while it runs.
dialog.rolesHint: Each role’s instructions and reading path go into the run. With none chosen, it takes the card’s own role, if it has one.

limits.title: Agent queue
limits.intro: Runs spend the same plan as your own chats, so the limits are low by default. They are yours, across projects.
limits.quietOn: Hold due runs during these hours
limits.timezoneHint: Schedules, quiet hours and the daily count use this zone.
limits.pauseHint: Runs already going finish. Nothing new starts until you resume.

noDevice.why: No device is paired with Hub yet, so there is nowhere to run.
noDevice.fix: Pair this machine in Settings › Devices.

noFolder.why: This project has no linked folder.
noFolder.fix: Link a folder in Settings › Devices.

decisions.title: Decided for you
decisions.summary: Choices taken: {answered} · Commands kept for you: {pending}
decisions.runItHint: Opens a chat on that folder, where it still asks for your approval.

cancel.title: Cancel “{title}”?
cancel.running: It is running now, so its turn stops.
cancel.weekly: It repeats every week, so the repeat ends too.
